description: Environment Setup and Baseline Verification - Verify all tests pass, run linting, confirm CI workflows syntax, establish baseline
steps: Run npm run test to confirm all 1,211 tests pass
Run npm run lint to verify ESLint passes on all files
Run npm run format -- --check to verify formatting is consistent
Review .github/workflows/ci.yml for any issues - check syntax and permissions
Review .github/workflows/label.yml and verify labeler.yml v5 syntax is correct
Document any CI/CD issues found in findings field
acceptance_criteria: Prettier check passes or files are formatted
Any issues are documented in findings
findings:
BASELINE VERIFICATION RESULTS:

1. TESTS: All 1,211 tests pass across 87 test files (Duration: 67.19s). No failures.

2. ESLINT: 0 errors, 191 warnings (all no-unused-vars). Warnings are non-blocking and acceptable for this codebase. Exit code 0.

3. PRETTIER: 306 files were reformatted. Code style is now consistent. Exit code 0.

CI/CD WORKFLOW ANALYSIS:

4. ci.yml - CORRECT:
   - Concurrency groups prevent duplicate runs
   - Timeout-minutes set on all jobs (5-30 min)
   - Least privilege permissions defined
   - Matrix strategy tests Node 20.x and 22.x on Ubuntu, plus Node 22.x on Windows
   - Cache optimization enabled for npm
   - Security audit runs first with fail-fast
   - CodeQL integrated as dependent job
   - Artifact retention configured (14-30 days)

5. label.yml - CORRECT:
   - Uses actions/labeler@v5 with correct syntax
   - sync-labels: true enabled
   - Branch name-based labeling via github-script@v7
   - Auto-creates missing labels

6. codeql.yml - CORRECT:
   - Weekly schedule (Sundays 00:00 UTC)
   - security-extended and security-and-quality query suites
   - Proper permissions (security-events: write)
   - Concurrency control enabled

7. labeler.yml - CORRECT:
   - Uses v5 format with 'changed-files' and 'any-glob-to-any-file'
   - Comprehensive label mappings for core, cli, documentation, testing, ci-cd, configuration, desktop, dependencies, security, scripts, examples, git-hooks, api

CONCLUSION: All acceptance criteria met. CI/CD workflows are properly configured.
